title: Everyone's Voice Matters: Quantifying Annotation Disagreement Using Demographic Information
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research. The key findings relate to the predictability of annotator disagreement from text and demographic information, with personal-level demographics providing a significant performance boost.

measurement_description: This paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on predicting annotator disagreement on subjective topics using demographic information such as age, gender, race, education, and political leaning.
